pages.name: Latvian Gambit: Mayet Attack
pages.notes: The overview and plan 1 had the c4-bishop targeting an f7-pawn that has gone (it is on f5); rewrote both around the a2-g8 diagonal, 3...fxe4 4.Nxe5 and Qh5+. Plan 2's ...Qh4 replaced with ...d5 and ...Qg5 (hitting e5 and g2).

pages.name: Latvian Gambit: Mayet Attack, Morgado Defense
pages.notes: Plan 1 attacked an f7-pawn that is on f5; rewrote it around the a2-g8 diagonal, Nxe5 (e5 is undefended) and Ng5 against the f7-square. British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Latvian Gambit: Svedenborg, 6.Nxg6 hxg6
pages.notes: Plan 1 had Qxh7 (the h-pawn has gone to g6) and ignored that the h5-queen is attacked by the g6-pawn and the h8-rook; rewrote it (Qxg6+ or Qxh8 ...dxc4). Plan 3 now says the h8-rook already hits the queen.

pages.name: Open Game: Gunderam Defence, 3.Nc3
pages.notes: The overview called the bishop blocked by ...Qe7 light-squared (it is the dark-squared f8-bishop); plan 4 had ...Be7 with the queen on e7, now ...g6 and ...Bg7. British spelling in the overview and plan 1.

pages.name: Philidor Defense
pages.notes: Plan 2 had ...exd4 before White has played d4; rewrote it around the Hanham set-up and later freeing breaks. British spelling in the overview and plan 1.

pages.name: Philidor Defense: Bird Gambit
pages.notes: Plan 1 had Nxc3 before Black takes on c3, '0-0' and an 'open d-file'; rewrote it. British spelling in the overview and plan 3.

pages.name: Philidor Defense: Hanham Variation, Delmar Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 had Nc3 with the c3-pawn on that square; now Nbd2 and Re1 with the Ng5 motif. Plan 2's ambiguous ...Nf6 is now ...Ngf6. British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Philidor Defense: Larsen Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 had ...c5 against a d4-pawn that is a knight; plan 3 had ...Bg4 pinning an f3-knight that is on d4. Rewrote both. British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Philidor Defense: Lion Variation, Bishop Sacrifice
pages.notes: Plan 1 had Qh5 through the f3-knight and plan 2 Kg8 without ...Kxf7 and Ng5+; rewrote both around 6...Kxf7 7.Ng5+ Kg8 8.Ne6. British spelling in plan 3.

pages.name: Philidor Defense: Lion Variation, Delayed Bishop Sacrifice
pages.notes: Plan 1 had an 'open f-file' for White (the f2-pawn is still there) and the queen to h5/f3 through the knight; plan 2 had the king to g8 without the moves before it. Rewrote both.
